q2_gaps: a bare, non-deictic SEASON as a Time filler ("summer"): the structured Time terms are Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute, and the season constants the instruction set names are deictic (last_spring, next_summer); nothing licenses a bare `summer` symbol (day-parts are the only bare-symbol precedent)

temporal-extent "through <period>" ("through summer"): During is licensed for during/while/throughout ONLY, Start/End need stated endpoints, and Measure ... duration needs a stated count — so the throughout/span sense of "through" has no licensed carrier and is silently dropped by a plain Time atom
notes: The generic bare-plural rule, the 0.8 strength for "often" with its QuantifierPhrase companion, and the sky_cat genus (noun modifier not exposed) are all correct. Time is the head the when-test selects for this PP, so the atom itself is defensible — what is lost is the extent sense of "through", recorded as a gap.
